verdict.rationale: Secureframe publishes a public REST API reference at api.secureframe.com/docs. It is resource-oriented, returns JSON API responses, supports Lucene search, documents request/response schemas for every endpoint group, embeds a full OpenAPI 3.0 spec, and states a dated versioning and backwards-compatibility policy. The feature page adds that the API reaches any existing object in the account and can push data for custom resources. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product through the API, and a separately downloadable raw OpenAPI spec URL.
